usageNote: 过去式版「期待」！后面只能接名词或动名词（-ing），比如 looked forward to seeing you，千万别跟原形动词！

examples.en: She looked forward to her vacation all year.
examples.zh: 她整年都在期待这次假期。

examples.en: We looked forward to meeting the new teacher.
examples.zh: 我们很期待见到新老师。
